spec.command: bash -c "set -o pipefail; cd /root/acr-vla-conformal-refinement && python -u src/evaluate.py --mode vla_only --baseline_mode mean --K 2 --benchmark spatial --seed 42 --n_rollouts 20 2>&1 | tee logs/eval-supp-k2mean-spatial-s42.log"
